title: Harriet Calloway's band, stranded in Grand Rapids
summary: He joins Harriet Calloway's band, a bus wreck in Montana, Winnipeg and Grand Rapids, where she abandons the band without pay.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: But anyway, I stayed with them for a while, and then Harriet Calloway came through Denver. Have you ever heard of her?
You told me about her when I did that interview for the book that I'm doing.
I remember I said, 'Well, I've heard of Blanche Calloway, but I've never heard of Harriet Calloway.' So tell that story.

Well, Harriet Calloway was...she claimed to be Cab's sister, but she really wasn't -- because I found that out from the manager of the band. He liked her and he was booking her. The trumpet player, I think I told you about him.

Anyway, so I joined the band, and we went up to Cheyenne, we had a bus wreck up in Montana. Basically that group I was with in Albuquerque had also joined the band with me when I joined Harriet's band. So we went up to Winnipeg and down to Grand Rapids, Michigan. And when we got to Grand Rapids, Michigan, Harriet cut out and left the band stranded, you know, without paying the band. Of course, I think that they thought they were slick.

Well, anyway, that's when Charles damn near went haywire, because she couldn't figure out how she could go off and leave him, as tight as he had been with him.
